endpoint: Numerical agreement on identical PCA coordinates: single steps on shared states within float32 rounding, and full fits judged against the reference's own spread across seeds; no biological accuracy or speed endpoint
inputDefinition: The seed-stability recipes' PCA coordinates computed by the installed CyteArc, subset to at most 6000 cells per dataset with seed 4444

criteria.assignmentStep: passed: with the diversity penalty off, the two kernels agree within 2e-06; with it on they implement different numerators, so equationsReproduced asks that each reproduce its own equation
criteria.correctionStep: Each tool reproduces the float64 equation of its pruning rule within 1e-05 of the largest absolute coordinate
criteria.fullFits: CyteArc's full fits agree with the reference's as closely as the reference's own fits agree across seeds: the median 15-NN overlap of CyteArc and reference fits over all seed pairs is at least the smallest overlap between two reference seeds, and the medians of the two tools' iLISI differ by at most the range of the reference's iLISI across seeds.

sharedStateChecks.stateDefinition: The same 200 real PCA rows, six unit centroids and identical observed and expected batch masses; no optimization or random initialization in the assignment check

correctionStep.nativeEquation: pruned batches keep their cells in each cluster's regression, without a batch term
correctionStep.referenceEquation: pruned batches leave each cluster's regression with their cells

sharedStateChecks.scope: Compiled float32 reference assignment kernel, a one-cluster correction and a correction step on the reference's own 100-cluster assignments; full fits keep independent initialization and convergence
